profile.headline: Full-Stack Software Engineer | Java, JavaScript, React, AWS | Multi-Role Experience in Transportation Software Solutions
profile.summary:
I am a Software Engineer with a passion for creating value through technology that enhances user experiences within the transportation industry. My goal is to make lives better by designing and implementing software solutions that are both fun and challenging to develop.

Over the years, I've worn many hats—from user to product owner, and now, a software engineer. This journey has equipped me with a unique perspective that allows me to empathize with users, understand complex requirements, and deliver solutions that not only work but resonate. 

One of my proudest achievements has been turning around struggling accounts by diving deep into their challenges. Through hard work and creativity, I've managed to propel these accounts forward by crafting solutions that align with customer needs while fitting within our product framework.

My approach to software development is rooted in listening, collaboration, and execution. I believe in clear, transparent communication to ensure all stakeholders are on the same page, which has been key to my success in delivering projects that exceed expectations.

I'm committed to lifelong learning, continuously seeking out new classes and researching the latest in tech to stay ahead. I'm particularly excited about exploring new technologies that promise to revolutionize how we approach software in transportation.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Developed and maintained scalable software solutions using Java, JavaScript, and React, enhancing system performance and user experience.
-Utilized AWS for cloud-based application deployment, ensuring high availability and scalability of services.
-Integrated Docker for containerization, simplifying development and deployment processes across multiple environments.
-Collaborated with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, leading to the successful implementation of features that directly addressed user needs.
-Drove continuous improvement in code quality through peer reviews, automated testing, and adherence to coding standards.

positions.title: Technical Product Owner
positions.description:
-Managed the product backlog, prioritizing features based on customer feedback, market research, and strategic business goals to maximize value.
-Defined clear, concise user stories and acceptance criteria, ensuring alignment between business needs and technical implementation.
-Facilitated agile ceremonies including sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives, driving team focus and productivity.
-Collaborated closely with engineering teams to translate product vision into actionable development tasks, ensuring technical feasibility and quality.
-Drove product development from conception through to launch, including managing product lifecycle, updates, and enhancements.
-Served as the key liaison between stakeholders, development teams, and users, ensuring all parties had a clear understanding of product direction and progress.

positions.title: Sr Product Owner
positions.description:
-Managed product backlog, prioritizing features based on business value and customer feedback, which resulted in increased user satisfaction and retention.
-Facilitated agile ceremonies like sprint planning, review, and retrospectives, fostering a culture of transparency and collective ownership.
-Translated complex user needs into product features, enhancing software usability and functionality.
-Led cross-departmental teams in the iterative development process, ensuring alignment with strategic product goals.

positions.title: Manager Implementation Services
positions.description:
-Led the implementation team in deploying transportation optimization solutions, ensuring projects were delivered on time, within scope, and to client satisfaction.
-Developed and refined implementation strategies that aligned with customer needs, optimizing logistics operations and reducing costs.
-Managed cross-functional teams, including technical support, customer success, and engineering, to ensure seamless integration of software solutions.
-Facilitated client relationships, serving as the primary point of contact for project updates, training, and issue resolution.
-Oversaw the customization of software to fit unique client requirements, enhancing system functionality and user adoption.
-Conducted training sessions for end-users, improving their understanding and utilization of the optimization tools.
-Analyzed implementation feedback to drive continuous improvement in service delivery, product features, and customer experience.
-Ensured compliance with industry standards and best practices in transportation logistics, maintaining high levels of service quality and innovation.

positions.title: Sr. Implementation Consultant
positions.description:
-Guided clients through the full lifecycle of software implementation, specializing in transportation and logistics solutions.
-Designed tailored implementation plans that aligned with specific client operational needs, enhancing efficiency and effectiveness.
-Led project teams, providing expert advice on system configuration, data migration, and integration strategies.
-Served as the key technical expert, troubleshooting complex issues and ensuring solutions met business objectives.
-Conducted comprehensive training sessions for client teams, ensuring a smooth transition to new systems and processes.
-Managed multiple implementation projects simultaneously, prioritizing tasks to meet deadlines and client expectations.
-Collaborated with sales, product development, and support teams to feedback client insights, driving product enhancements.
-Evaluated post-implementation performance, offering recommendations for further optimization and user adoption.

positions.title: Demand Planning Manager
positions.description:
-Developed and maintained statistical forecast models to predict demand for a wide range of confectionery products, enhancing inventory accuracy and minimizing waste.
-Led cross-functional collaboration with sales, marketing, and supply chain teams to ensure demand forecasts aligned with promotional activities, seasonal trends, and market dynamics.
-Analyzed historical sales data, market trends, and consumer behavior to refine forecasting models, supporting accurate production planning and inventory management.
-Implemented continuous improvement initiatives in the demand planning process, leveraging external data sources for better market insight and forecast accuracy.
-Managed the integration of demand planning systems post-acquisition by Lindt & Sprüngli, aligning processes with global best practices to support Russell Stover's growth.
-Facilitated the transition from small-batch to more scalable production planning, ensuring product availability while maintaining the brand's tradition of quality.
-Reported on forecast accuracy, identifying variances and driving corrective actions to improve service levels and reduce excess inventory.
-Contributed to strategic planning by providing data-driven insights into product lifecycle management, helping to shape the product portfolio and innovation strategy.

positions.title: Demand Analyst
positions.description:
-Conducted detailed analysis of sales data, trends, and market conditions to generate accurate demand forecasts for confectionery products.
-Supported the demand planning team by providing insights into consumer buying patterns, seasonal fluctuations, and promotional impacts.
-Utilized forecasting tools and statistical methods to enhance the precision of demand predictions, aiding in inventory optimization.
-Collaborated with sales, marketing, and operations teams to understand product promotions, new product launches, and market expansions, ensuring forecasts reflected these factors.
-Monitored and reported on forecast accuracy, identifying discrepancies and working with stakeholders to adjust forecasts as necessary.
-Assisted in the development of demand planning strategies, contributing to the alignment of production schedules with anticipated demand.
-Participated in the evaluation of new software and tools that could improve demand forecasting capabilities within the company.
-Contributed to post-acquisition integration efforts with Lindt & Sprüngli, adapting demand planning processes to fit within a larger, global framework.

positions.title: Transportation Procurement Manager
positions.description:
-Managed the procurement of transportation services, negotiating contracts with carriers to optimize cost-efficiency and service quality for the distribution of food products.
-Developed and implemented transportation strategies that aligned with the company's supply chain objectives, focusing on cost reduction and service level improvements post-acquisition.
-Led the integration of transportation networks following the merger, ensuring a seamless transition and leveraging synergies for enhanced logistics performance.
-Analyzed transportation data to assess carrier performance, freight costs, and network efficiency, driving decisions on mode selection and route optimization.
-Collaborated with internal stakeholders, including manufacturing, sales, and logistics teams, to forecast transportation needs and align with production and demand planning.
-Negotiated favorable terms with shipping companies, leveraging volume for discounts while maintaining compliance with safety and regulatory standards.
-Implemented sustainable transportation practices, focusing on reducing the carbon footprint through strategic carrier selection and route planning.
-Oversaw the development of KPIs for transportation operations, regularly reporting on performance against these metrics to senior management.

positions.title: Transportation Analyst
positions.description:
-Analyzed transportation data to optimize logistics operations, focusing on cost, efficiency, and service levels for global distribution of consumer health, hygiene, and home products.
-Developed transportation models to evaluate different scenarios, supporting strategic decisions on carrier selection, routing, and mode of transport.
-Monitored freight expenditures, identifying opportunities for cost savings through rate negotiations, consolidation, or alternative shipping methods.
-Collaborated with supply chain teams to ensure alignment between transportation plans and inventory management, production schedules, and market demands.
-Conducted regular performance reviews of carriers, assessing reliability, transit times, and compliance with company standards.
-Utilized transportation management systems (TMS) to track shipments, manage load planning, and provide visibility into the supply chain.
-Supported sustainability initiatives by evaluating the environmental impact of transportation choices, aiming to reduce the carbon footprint.
-Prepared detailed reports and dashboards for management, highlighting key metrics, trends, and areas for improvement in transportation logistics.

positions.title: Logistics Intern
positions.description: Assist Distribution Manager for all vinyl siding and windows orders for Midwest region of company.
